records.eligibility_summary: Entering freshmen at an eligible Tennessee postsecondary institution who enroll within 16 months of graduating from an eligible Tennessee high school; standard route requires either a minimum 21 ACT / 1060 SAT or a minimum 3.0 overall GPA under the Uniform Grading Policy. ACT/SAT must be a national or state test date before first college enrollment; ACT Residual and ACT Superscore are not accepted. Home-school, GED and HiSET routes require a 21 ACT plus route-specific conditions.
records.residency_requirement: Tennessee resident as classified by the Tennessee Board of Regents.
records.gpa_requirement: 3.0 overall GPA (4.0 scale, Uniform Grading Policy weighting) is one qualifying route.
records.test_requirement: 21 ACT composite or 1060 SAT (exclusive of essay) is one qualifying route.
records.award_amount_text: Four-year institutions and two-year institutions with on-campus housing: up to $2,250 per full-time semester as freshman/sophomore and up to $2,850 per full-time semester as junior/senior. Two-year institutions: up to $1,600 per full-time semester as freshman/sophomore. Summer enrollment is eligible.
records.renewal_requirements: Continuous fall/spring enrollment at an eligible institution and satisfactory academic progress. Minimum 2.75 cumulative GPA at the 24- and 48-attempted-hour benchmarks; minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA at 72 hours and beyond, or 2.75-2.99 cumulative with a 3.0 prior-semester GPA while enrolled full time (semester-to-semester review). A student who loses HOPE for GPA may regain it once at a later benchmark; GPA-based loss cannot be appealed. Terminates at the earlier of an advanced degree or five years from initial postsecondary enrollment.
records.source_publisher: Tennessee Higher Education Commission / College for TN

records.eligibility_summary: Need-based supplement for students who meet Tennessee HOPE Scholarship requirements.

records.award_amount_text: Up to $750 per semester at four-year institutions; up to $250 per semester at two-year institutions, as a supplement to HOPE.
records.renewal_requirements: Same continuing-eligibility rules as HOPE. Terminates at the earlier of an advanced degree or five years from initial postsecondary enrollment.
records.application_method: Complete the FAFSA; applies with HOPE.
records.source_publisher: Tennessee Higher Education Commission / College for TN

records.award_amount_text: Up to $500 per semester as a supplement to HOPE, including summer.
records.renewal_requirements: Same continuing-eligibility rules as HOPE. Terminates at the earlier of an advanced degree or five years from initial postsecondary enrollment.

records.eligibility_summary: For students enrolled in a certificate or diploma program at a Tennessee College of Applied Technology who have not previously received the grant; requires satisfactory academic progress and continuous enrollment.

records.eligibility_summary: Scholarship, mentoring and community-service program covering eligible tuition and mandatory fees not covered by other gift aid at Promise-eligible institutions. Eligible students graduate from a TN, bordering or home school (or earn an approved equivalency before age 19) and attend a mandatory Promise meeting.
records.residency_requirement: Tennessee resident under Tennessee Board of Regents classification policy; U.S. citizen or eligible non-citizen.
records.award_amount_text: Variable last-dollar amount after Pell, HOPE, TSAA and other gift aid.
records.renewal_requirements: At least 16 hours of community service for each year in the program (the Class of 2027 senior guide lists eight reported hours before initial enrollment); continuous fall/spring enrollment (or TCAT continuous enrollment); 2.0 GPA at the end of each academic year at a community college or eligible four-year institution, or SAP at a TCAT.
records.application_method: Complete the Tennessee Promise application in the THEC Student Portal, the FAFSA, the mandatory meeting and ongoing program requirements.
records.deadline_text: Class of 2027: Promise application by November 2, 2026; FAFSA by April 1, 2027; application opened April 1, 2026.
